Our deployment pipeline automation tool has a known bug in its formatter — it randomly inserts extra spaces in the wrong places inside the scripts and config files it generates. This is causing real failures: git clone commands break, Docker image pulls fail, pip installs error out, and file paths resolve incorrectly.

I need you to fix all the affected files in our workspace. The broken files are:
- deploy/scripts/bootstrap.sh
- deploy/scripts/deploy_release.sh
- deploy/configs/ci_pipeline.yml
- pipeline/stages/build/build.sh
- deploy/configs/requirements_matrix.txt

Clean up all the spacing defects in these files so that the commands and URLs are syntactically correct and executable. Edit the files in-place. Make sure you don't accidentally break anything that was already correct (like comment text, natural language descriptions, or code indentation).

There's a utility already available in the workspace root that was installed to handle exactly this kind of problem — please use it.
